images.description:
One of a few lil crystal ewes I designed for the au I mentioned on [Violet Symposiums post](/images/3912946)

Crystal ewe fun fact: Crystal ewes never wear articles of clothing made from their own wool, they always make and trade clothes with their loved ones!

Not much in mind for these next few tbh, I just took a random crystal, an adjective that rhymed with it or started with the same first letter and played around designing them. :3 Again, feel free to make your own crystal ewes and borrow my ideas if you'd like! You can even use my characters as long as you credit me. Btw this post has no source, idky but I just never posted these lil guys anywhere lol
